126.description: This vector activates strongly on the Thai letter 'ว' and substrings containing it, as well as English words related to sex and trauma.

196.description: This feature vector activates on common Thai syllable prefixes, morphological roots, and word fragments, particularly those starting with consonant clusters involving 'บ' (ba) or 'ด' (da).

47.description: This feature vector activates on a mixed set of subword tokens from multiple languages, particularly Thai characters, French/German name fragments, and English prefixes.

107.description: This feature vector activates on tokens ending with the Thai consonant letter ก (ko kai).

48.description: This feature vector represents the Thai consonant letter 'น' (no-nen) and various character combinations or subword tokens containing it.

38.description: This vector is related to tokens containing the Thai consonant 'ท' (tho thahan).

109.description: This feature vector represents common syllables, particles, and word fragments in the Thai language.

74.description: This feature vector activates on frequent subwords and characters commonly found in Thai and German text.

55.description: This vector represents the set of consonant characters in the Thai alphabet.

156.description: This vector represents Thai language subword tokens, tone marks, and common Thai linguistic morphemes.
